Both embedded EXIF dates are post-1993 processing metadata, not the capture date: 2023-02-02 is the Commons crop, and DateTimeOriginal 2020-12-23 16:55:56 predates the video's listed YouTube publication of 2020-12-27, so its origin is unclear.
